title: Recovery inventory quarantine coordinator
description: Objective: compose restored durable intents, scheduler resource/integration records, and real node-side inventory into one fail-closed post-cursor reconciliation and project-wide effect embargo. Deliverable: a daemon recovery inventory coordinator that requires the exact configured class set (provider/process/lock, resource, workspace, integration, Git, artifact), joins each observed post-N item to restored intent under the new incarnation, records absent/adopted/quarantined dispositions, persists a canonical coverage/reconciliation digest, and gates work claim/effect activation until every class and item is closed. MEASURED GAP at HEAD 1ce0059: runner ordinary-restart classification can return QUARANTINED and scheduler resources can be QUARANTINED, but daemon reconcileOnRestart trusts caller-supplied attempts, no service enumerates configured classes, and no production claim gate reads a disaster-recovery embargo. NOT in scope: ordinary restart timing, optimistic orphan adoption, creating missing history, minting recovery identity, approving recovery.complete, or tests/fault. Hard dependencies: task-b6e3dd2af916490fb2bc4d375a530683 (installed quiesced restore), task-8a01c025b65246aca09e69d82e009587 (current incarnation fence), and task-0325dcf7ee744123b40cf583230c7b6a (node-side inventory). Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/recovery/effect-inventory.* plus minimal work/effect admission and daemon export wiring. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: The production coordinator derives the required class set from daemon configuration and demands one cursor/incarnation-bound COMPLETE coverage proof for provider/process/lock, resource, workspace, integration, Git, and artifact classes; omitted, duplicate, unknown, or extra class evidence cannot satisfy coverage.

Every post-N item is deterministically classified as proven absent, safely adopted only to an exact restored intent under the current incarnation, or quarantined as an orphan; an unmatched item is never inserted into restored history or automatically repeated.

Missing inventory, adapter/coverage uncertainty, non-fenceable unknown state, artifact/key proof failure, or an unresolved item persists truth `UNKNOWN` and returns stable `UNKNOWN_TRUTH` at layer `RECOVERY_INVENTORY`, with the precise upstream adapter code retained.

Daemon work-claim and effect-activation production paths consult the persisted project recovery embargo before allocating authority; unresolved/unknown inventory returns `RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED` from layer `RECOVERY_INVENTORY` with no attempt, slot, lease, effect, or spend.

The frozen canonical coverage/reconciliation record binds project, backup cursor/generation, current incarnation/key epoch, configured class set, source proof digests, item dispositions, and quarantine references; any byte change alters or invalidates its digest.
Focused tests drive production runner/scheduler/store surfaces, assert all seven configured classes generated, pin exact code/layer precedence, and mutation-check the production embargo branch.

comments.author: architect-a42f4965
comments.content: Planning audit at HEAD c0c5929 found the task is not implementable as written; created prerequisite production tasks: task-fb997625e61f487a9afa1cc56c67687a (publish four real runner adapter registrations), task-47eecd22b3b94a57a9632672c19ebd97 (durable resource/integration inventory providers), task-e33747f982e0452a9f9d784fd1cb914d (non-vacuous daemon four-leg claim/effect.activate ingress plus persisted embargo), and task-f6cf8d16c2654641a92b0ee36924de0c (freeze 7-population mapping and durable quarantine/reconciliation record). Exact contradiction: design line 978 names 7 populations; CORE-S14 names 6 categories; runner contract has 4 combined classes; adding resource yields 5 proof classes; description lists 6; DoD says 7. Do not duplicate combined proofs to fabricate seven. Coordinator should be re-promoted only after these prerequisites land and its stale class wording is reconciled against the frozen contract.

blockedReason: Current production cannot satisfy the task without inventing authority. At HEAD c0c5929, @moe/runner exposes only four combined inventory classes and does not root-export any of the four adapter registration factories; @moe/scheduler has an in-memory ResourceRow transition surface but no durable inventory reader; no production integration-attempt inventory record exists; no daemon recovery quarantine/reconciliation persistence exists; claimWork (four execution-authority legs) and @moe/runner activateEffect have no daemon production caller, so the required zero attempt/slot/lease/effect/spend embargo assertion would be vacuous. Cardinality is mechanically contradictory: design line 978 names seven semantic populations, CORE-S14 names six categories, runner has four combined classes, adding resource gives five proof classes, the task description lists six groups, and DoD 6 requires seven generated classes while the collector rejects unknown/extra classes. Created prerequisite tasks task-fb997625e61f487a9afa1cc56c67687a, task-47eecd22b3b94a57a9632672c19ebd97, task-e33747f982e0452a9f9d784fd1cb914d, and task-f6cf8d16c2654641a92b0ee36924de0c.
